newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka has been adjusted downward against U.S. dollar to 43.10/30 from 42.65/85 effective on Wednesday, a circular by the central Bangladesh Bank said on Tuesday.
The bank gave no explanation for its move but commercial bank officials said the taka's downward adjustment was aimed at boosting the country's exports.
The taka was last adjusted downward on February 5.
